references.text: Describes the event where Jesus is brought to Pilate, which parallels the event in Mark
Luke's account of Jesus being brought before Pilate, showing a parallel event
John's description of Jesus being brought to Pilate, which is a parallel event
A psalm that speaks of counsel against the Lord's anointed can be seen as a prediction of the counsel against Jesus
Paul mentions Jesus being handed over, which relates to the event where Jesus was handed over to Pilate
